title: J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components. First, a training-free Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning (GEAR) reweights token candidates over existing model embeddings, which monotonically optimizes geometric consensus among candidate tokens in embedding space at each step. Second, we introduce an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) communication interface that gives the Receiver two complementary views of the Sender's reasoning. The H channel supplies continuous inputs derived from feedback distributions, while the J channel conveys intermediate-state cues in vocabulary-indexed Jacobian-lens coordinates. translated_title: J-Comm：基于雅可比引导的大语言模型智能体间潜在通信
translated_abstract: 潜在通信既需要一个有效的连续推理过程，也需要一个接口使外部模型能够利用其中间计算结果。我们提出了J-Comm框架，包含两个核心组件。首先，一种免训练的潜在推理几何一致性方法（GEAR），在现有模型嵌入之上对候选token进行重加权，在每一步中单调地优化嵌入空间中候选token之间的几何共识。其次，我们引入了H+J（隐状态与雅可比）通信接口，为接收方提供发送方推理过程的两个互补视角。H通道提供源自反馈分布的连续输入，而J通道则以词汇索引的雅可比透镜坐标传递中间状态线索。直观地说，H为接收方提供推理所需的输入，而J则在其计算过程中提供额外的引导。接收方重建这些
tldr: 提出J-Comm框架，结合免训练的GEAR几何一致性方法与H+J（隐状态与雅可比）双通道通信接口，实现大语言模型智能体之间基于雅可比引导的潜在通信。
en_tdlr: J-Comm is a framework enabling Jacobian-guided latent communication between LLM agents through a training-free GEAR geometric agreement method and an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) dual-channel communication interface.
